title: 第 12章农村日常2-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    跟着八叔去他家挑了几样工具，也就是装装样子。回到地头告诉爷爷中午不回来吃饭了，就上山了。一路上山，边走边找枯倒的大树。

    一路走，一路收大概两个小时就收了五棵大树。然后找到一块儿空地，取出大锅。看见里面还有半锅炖肉，开整。一顿风卷残云，终于吃饱了。

    靠在一棵大树下，回忆着前世看见的水车样式。这东西王野在前世是在一个植物园里看见过。这东西已经不常用了。摆在公园里成了一件娱乐活动。十块钱一次。

    王野前世也好奇才玩了一次。这东西结构挺简单的。在空间里借用精神力，一会儿就做出来了。组装好取出实验了一下，不错，是那么回事。

    怕引起爷爷他们的怀疑，王野又在空地上锻炼身体。站桩，打拳，还用石头做了几个哑铃。饿了就吃肉，吃饱了继续。不知不觉就到了四点钟，回家。

    离村子不远找了个没人的地方，取出水车，又拿了三只野鸡。用藤蔓绑好拖着就回家了。

    “爷爷奶奶，我回来了！”

    爷爷赶紧过来，看见王野后面拖着一堆木头急忙问：“小野，咋样，能行吗？”

    王野自信的说：“爷爷，你得对你大孙子有信心。趁着天还没黑，走，咱去河边试试！”

    “老二老三，给老子滚过来！”爷爷大声喊着。

    接着就见二叔三叔急忙跑了过来。奶奶和太爷爷也围了过来。

    “怎么了，这是？”太爷爷好奇的问。

    “爹，这是你重孙子做的水车，我们去试试好使不。老二老三，你俩抬着，你他娘的轻点，要是弄坏了，我打断你们狗腿！”

    王野笑呵呵的说：“爷爷，没事儿，这玩意儿结实结实着呢！”

    河边距离最近的地都有一公里多远。而且现在水位下降的厉害，原来水面最窄的地方都有十几二十米，现在最窄的地方只有三四米了。

    在两个叔叔的帮助下，没一会儿就组装好了。王野站在脚踏板上叫上二叔三叔，简单教了一下就会用了。三人一起发力，几下就见水车就开始出水了，而且水流还不小。

    这把爷爷激动的不行。有了水车，再修个简单的水渠，那今年的粮食算是保住了。

    “老二，你在这儿守着，下半夜让老三来换你。”

    “好嘞！爹。”二叔三叔应道。

    王野，爷爷，三叔回家了，一进门奶奶就问：“咋样，好使吗？”

    爷爷兴奋的说：“好使，可好使了，那水流的哗哗的！而且两个人就能操作。”

    奶奶自豪道：“还是我大孙子厉害，你们这一村子都是一群笨牛，就知道卖傻力气。学学我大孙子，看一眼就给你们找到了这么一个好法子。”

    爷爷面上露出一抹遗憾：“要是我大孙子早点来，就更好了。”

    王野解释道：“爷爷，可不是这么回事儿的，我来的早也没用，我是前段时间才在书上看见这东西的。来早了我也不会弄呀！”

    老爷子颔首：“对！这就是命，老天爷派我重孙孙来救咱们的。”

    王野压低声音道：“太爷爷，现在可不能说这话。要是被外人听到，你重孙子可要倒大霉的。”

    太爷赶紧说：“不说，不说，谁也不许说。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

I followed Uncle Eight to his house to pick out a few things, just to show off.When I returned to the field, I told my grandpa that he would not be back for lunch at noon, and then went up the mountain.Along the way up the mountain, I looked for fallen trees.

We walked all the way and harvested five big trees in about two hours.Then find an open space and take out the cauldron.I saw there was still half a pot of stew inside, so I opened it.After a long meal, I was finally full.

Leaning under a big tree, I recalled the style of waterwheel I saw in my previous life.Wang Ye had seen this thing in a botanical garden in his previous life.This thing is no longer commonly used.Placing it in the park has become an entertainment activity.Ten bucks a time.

Wang Ye was also curious and played it once in his previous life.The structure of this thing is quite simple.Borrowing mental power in space, it was done in a short time.After assembling it, I took it out and experimented. Yes, that's what happened.

Afraid of arousing suspicion from Grandpa and the others, Wang Ye exercised in the open space again.I stood in stance, boxed, and made some dumbbells with stones.Eat meat when you are hungry and continue when you are full.Before I knew it, it was four o'clock and I went home.

I found a deserted place not far from the village, took out the waterwheel, and picked up three pheasants.He was tied up with vines and dragged home.

"Grandpa and grandma, I'm back!"

Grandpa came over quickly and saw Wang Ye dragging a pile of wood behind him and asked hurriedly: "Xiaoye, what are you doing? Can it be done?"

Wang Ye said confidently: "Grandpa, you have to have confidence in your eldest grandson. Let's go to the river and try it before it gets dark!"

"Second and third, get here here!" Grandpa shouted loudly.

Then I saw my second uncle and third uncle running over in a hurry.Grandma and great-grandfather also gathered around.

"What's wrong, what is this?" Grandpa asked curiously.

"Dad, this is the waterwheel made by your great-grandson. Let's go and try it out. You two carry the second and third child. Be gentle as fuck. If it gets damaged, I'll break your legs!"

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Grandpa, it's okay, this thing is very strong!"

The river is more than a kilometer away from the nearest land.Moreover, the water level has dropped drastically. The narrowest part of the water surface used to be more than ten or twenty meters, but now it is only three or four meters.

With the help of two uncles, it was assembled in a short time.Wang Ye stood on the footrest and called his second and third uncles. After a brief lesson, he learned how to use it.The three of them worked together, and within a few seconds the water tanker began to discharge water, and the water flow was not small.

This made grandpa very excited.With the waterwheel and the construction of a simple canal, this year's food supply can be saved.

"Second brother, you stay here and let third child replace you in the middle of the night."

"Okay! Dad." The second uncle and the third uncle responded.

Wang Ye, grandpa, and third uncle came home. As soon as they walked in, grandma asked: "How are you doing? Does it work?"

Grandpa said excitedly: "It works, it works, the water flows loudly! And two people can operate it."

Grandma said proudly: "My eldest grandson is still the best. Your village is a bunch of stupid cows, and they only know how to use their strength. Learn from my eldest grandson, and he found such a good way for you at a glance."

There was a trace of regret on Grandpa’s face: “It would be better if my eldest grandson came earlier.”

Wang Ye explained: "Grandpa, that's not what happened. It's useless if I come early. I only saw this thing in a book some time ago. I won't know how to do it if I come early!"

The old man nodded: "Yes! This is fate. God sent my great-grandson to save us."

Wang Ye lowered his voice and said: "Grandpa, you can't say this now. If outsiders hear it, your great-grandson will be in bad luck."

The grandfather quickly said: "Don't say it, don't say it, no one is allowed to say it."

title_en: Chapter 12 Rural Daily Life 2 - "Traveling through 60 and taking space as a security guard"
